records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Confirming that Blue Systems' Wrenfield subscription has been canceled as requested. If you change your mind, you can always come back.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Blue Systems!
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, invite, or milestone (stall_reasons). Two outbound emails [email:60ad5e45, email:0f0550e1] drew no reply; welcome call was held [calendar:cfd31da8], a mild positive, but zero product activity since. Starter plan, no tickets, no stated urgency — low odds of self-serve activation in 8 days.

draft.subject: Quick help setting up your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week — good to talk through what Blue Systems wants out of Wrenfield.

The quickest next step is creating your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
